# Universal Transmissions

> The visual lexicon of hidden knowledge — sacred geometry, symbolic art, and the Codex Oracle.

Universal Transmissions is the sacred-art and symbolic-code site of artist and author **Hakan Hisim**. It hosts 35 original artworks (sacred geometry, cymatics, alchemical and esoteric symbols), the interactive correspondence-codex oracle, and long-form essays on esoteric tradition.

## About
- Creator: Hakan Hisim
- Language: English
- Domain: https://www.universal-transmissions.com

## Core pages
- https://www.universal-transmissions.com/ — Home
- https://www.universal-transmissions.com/gallery — The 35 original artworks in sacred geometry and esoteric symbolism
- https://www.universal-transmissions.com/journal — Long-form essays on sacred geometry, cymatics, alchemy, kabbalah, meditation, and esoteric art
- https://www.universal-transmissions.com/codex — The interactive correspondence-codex divination tool
- https://www.universal-transmissions.com/store — Physical and digital editions of the Universal Transmissions Codex
- https://www.universal-transmissions.com/connect — Contact and commissions
